about_short_description.short_description: Gigster is the first team intelligence engine, enabling software development teams to achieve 30% higher efficiency.

product.name: Fully Managed Software Development
product.description: A service where Gigster takes full responsibility for the software development process from start to finish, delivering the product within defined scope, time, and budget.

product.name: Dedicated Teams
product.description: Provision of skilled software development teams dedicated exclusively to a client’s projects, allowing flexibility to scale and meet business objectives.

product.name: Talent On Demand
product.description: On-demand access to vetted software development talent that integrates with a client’s existing team to accelerate project progress without recruitment overhead.

product.name: AI Readiness Assessment
product.description: A 10-minute online assessment tool that evaluates an organization’s preparedness for AI implementation and provides actionable insights for AI adoption.

product.name: Custom Software Development Services
product.description: Custom software development projects executed by Gigster’s engineering teams, covering AI, machine learning, blockchain, IoT, cloud, and enterprise software.

product.name: Applications and Platforms Development
product.description: Development of scalable software applications and platforms including mobile, cloud-first, workflow management, enterprise software, IoT, and digital commerce solutions.
